board_shortcuts_hint: With the map focused, Tab selects the nearest unvisited unit that can still act. Shift + Tab goes back through previous selections. End ends the turn. Escape cancels the selection. Press it again to leave map navigation. Outside the map, Tab keeps its usual function.
expected_income_hint: Expected income at the start of this player's next turn, if these buildings remain under their control.
confirm_end_turn: Confirm end of turn when actions remain
end_turn_warning: Commander, some units can still act. Confirm the end of your turn?
map_editor_mirror_help: Odd rows and columns only. Copies the upper half to the lower half, plus left → right on the centre row, rotating and swapping teams. Centre: neutral, no units. Undo restores the previous map. Bridge supports are automatically placed on water below horizontal bridges.
map_editor_mirror_dimensions: Mirror mode requires odd rows and columns (3–31). Create an odd-sized grid before enabling it.
map_editor_mirror_centre_unit: The centre cell must remain unit-free in mirror mode.
map_editor_mirror_enabled: 180° mirror enabled. Loading or importing another map turns it off.
online_intro: A duel between commanders? Invite a friend. The host commands blue, the guest commands red. Blue makes the first move.
online_host_steps: Send this link to your friend and keep this page open. The game starts when they join.
online_guest_steps: Your opponent awaits, Commander. Join the match to answer the challenge.
online_copy_manually: Automatic copying is unavailable. Select and copy the text manually.
online_error_invalid: This invitation is invalid. Copy the complete link or code and try again.
online_error_incompatible: The game versions differ. Both players should reload and create a new invitation.
online_error_map: This invitation belongs to another map. Open the original invitation link.
online_error_unsupported: This browser does not support the connection. Try a recent version of Chrome, Firefox or Safari.
online_error_failed: The connection could not be established. Check both devices, try another network, or start over with a new invitation.
online_waiting_detail: The game starts once both devices have loaded the battlefield.
online_paused_detail: The other device is not responding. Play resumes if the connection returns. If a page was closed or reloaded, create a new game.
inspect_enemy_hint: With no friendly unit selected, tap or click an enemy: stripes show its current attack range and dots show where it can go with its remaining movement. Tap it again or press Escape to hide these indicators.
enemy_reachable: Reachable by the inspected enemy with its remaining movement
map_13_description: Keep your boots dry. Two narrow grass crossings connect the banks of this small river battlefield.
map_14_description: Cross the bridges and winding roads to contest two big cities between the riverbanks.
map_10_description: Lead 11 units per side through flooded passes. Hold the crossings and cover the skies.
map_11_description: Deploy 12 units per side along a broad ridge. Seize high ground and guard your flanks.
map_12_description: Command 12 units per side across a vast estuary. Split your forces and control both banks.
stat_range_bonus: Range bonus for ranged ground units
meta_description: Play Pixel’s War for free in your browser. Capture cities, build your army and face the AI or a friend, online or on the same device.
hero: At your command! Your troops are ready. Capture cities, call in reinforcements and outmaneuver the AI or a friend.
home_rules_1: Face the AI or play against a friend, online or on the same device. Move your units, attack and capture buildings.
home_rules_2: On PC, use the arrow keys or your chosen WASD/ZQSD layout to move, Enter to confirm, Escape to cancel and Space to capture.
home_rules_3: Infantry captures buildings. Cities and big cities provide income, hospitals heal, and production buildings create units. Destroy all opposing units to win.
infantry_group_description: The only unit type that can capture and secure buildings.
aircraft_group_description: Flying units cross every terrain at the same cost.
unit_artillery_description: Long-range support. Effective against infantry and vehicles.
unit_anti_air_description: Air defense. Cannot attack ground units.
unit_helicopter_description: Fast flying unit. Strong against infantry.
unit_plane_description: Powerful flying unit. Strong against helicopters.
terrain_road_description: The quickest route, with nowhere to hide.
terrain_grass_description: Good old grass. Cheap, open and dependable.
terrain_forest_description: A slow stroll with solid cover.
terrain_moutain_description: Good cover. Ranged ground units can reach one extra cell from this elevated position.
terrain_water_description: Water is life. Only ships and flying units can cross it.
terrain_building_description: A useful place worth fighting for.
building_city_description: Makes 200$ each turn. War is expensive.
building_hospital_description: Restores 50 health per turn. The medical team is ready for your wounded.
building_factory_description: This is where ground units can be trained or built.
building_airport_description: Builds flying units. Please mind the propellers.
map_1_description: Capture key buildings, grow your income and build a balanced army.
map_2_description: Cross a wider battlefield where every move and every unit matters.
map_3_description: Take control of the central crossroads and the buildings along its four approaches.
map_4_description: Meet in the middle along a long road and capture the buildings on either side.
map_5_description: Cross uneven passes and control a winding road through the valley.
map_6_description: Push through a narrow corridor and contest its two airports.
map_7_description: Manage a wide front where distant objectives reward careful planning.
map_8_description: Follow a winding road and capture the buildings on either side.
map_9_description: Follow winding roads between pools and contest the big cities.
inspect_hint: Select a tile, then click or tap its thumbnail in the action bar to view its terrain and unit details.
free_building: This building is occupied. Move the unit to make room for reinforcements.
goal_text: Destroy every opposing unit to win.
turn_step_1: Each turn, you can use all your units. Select them to move through highlighted cells within their movement allowance.
turn_step_2: Use their actions to attack enemies within range or capture buildings with infantry. Each unit has its own action allowance.
turn_step_3: Confirm moves and switch between units in any order. End your turn once you have taken all the actions you want.
rules_building_1: Capture a building twice to claim it. Its owner can secure interrupted captures.
rules_building_2: Cities provide 200$ and big cities 300$ per turn. Hospitals restore 50 health. Army bases, airports and naval bases produce units.
rules_building_3: Terrain changes movement and defense. Flying units always spend 1 movement per cell.
touch_step_1: Tap or click one of your units to select it.
touch_step_2: Tap or click a cell marked with a dot to move there, or a marked enemy to attack. Stripes show attack range in the unit’s team color.
touch_step_3: Use the action buttons to confirm, cancel, capture or end your turn.
minimap_hint: Tap or drag to move the view.
unit_infantry_sniper_description: Strong against infantry. Cannot fire at close range.
rules_mountain: Mountains cost 4 movement points. Ranged ground units on them gain +1 maximum range, their minimum range stays the same.
play_local: Play with someone on this device
ai_fair_play: Same armies, same budget, same rules. You command red and the AI commands blue.
ai_easy_rule_1: Advances toward enemies and captures nearby buildings.
ai_easy_rule_2: Takes available shots without planning attack combinations.
ai_easy_rule_3: Usually buys cheap reinforcements. May buy a transport to help infantry cover long distances.
ai_medium_rule_1: Prioritizes kills, captures and favourable combat trades.
ai_medium_rule_2: Considers enemy reach, terrain cover and hospital recovery.
ai_medium_rule_3: Recruits counters to your army and keeps infantry for captures.
ai_hard_rule_1: Uses medium tactics and plans two attacks ahead to reduce retaliation.
ai_hard_rule_2: Defends threatened buildings and supports durable front-line units with ranged fire.
ai_hard_rule_3: Reassesses after each action and balances counters with ranged support.
player_turn: Player {player}, your troops await your orders!
ai_expert_rule_1: Projects your next turn and its own follow-up before committing.
ai_expert_rule_2: Plans counters across bases and airports, saving for important recruits.
ai_expert_rule_3: Prioritizes city income, denies captures and protects production.
home_rules_mobile: On mobile, tap a unit, then a highlighted cell to move or an enemy within range to attack. Use the action buttons to confirm, cancel, capture or end your turn. Swipe the map or use the minimap to explore the battlefield.
ai_victory_message: The AI has won this battle, Commander.
online_error_service: The connection service is unavailable. Check your internet connection and try again.
online_error_unavailable: This game is no longer available or already has two players. Ask your friend for a new invitation.
legal_intro: Pixel’s War is a free browser game by John Does it. You can play against the AI, share a device, or invite a friend online. No account is required.
legal_use: Play fairly and respect your opponent. Do not disrupt the service or try to access someone else’s game without their invitation. The game may change or be temporarily unavailable. Progress is kept in the current page only. Refreshing or closing it ends the match.
legal_cookie: The pixelswars-settings cookie remembers your language, keyboard layout, sound, music and board animation settings when you change them. It contains no account identifier and is not used for advertising or analytics. It is a session cookie with no expiry date. A browser that restores sessions may retain it after closing.
legal_cookie_manage: Change these settings in Options and help, or remove the cookie using your browser’s site-data controls. Blocking cookies prevents preferences from being saved between visits. The game code includes no advertising or analytics trackers.
legal_online: Creating or joining a game contacts PeerJS Cloud to exchange a random session identifier and WebRTC connection details. When configured, Metered provides connection servers and a TURN relay. Otherwise, Google’s STUN service helps establish a direct connection. These providers receive technical connection data, including IP addresses. Opening an invitation alone does not contact them.
legal_shared: Actions and game state travel between the browsers, directly or through an encrypted relay connection. Your opponent’s browser can learn your IP address. Share invitations only with people you trust. The host validates actions and holds the reference state. This mode is intended for friendly games, without guaranteed protection against cheating.
legal_limits: Some networks or browser settings can prevent a connection even with a relay. Relay availability also depends on the provider’s service and quota. Temporary interruptions pause play. It resumes if the connection returns. Reloading or closing a page ends the session, and both players must agree to a rematch.
legal_hosting: The published site is hosted by GitHub Pages. Hosting and connection providers may process technical logs to operate their services, under their own policies. Pixel’s War does not control their retention periods. External credit links open the respective providers’ websites.
legal_contact: For questions about the game, your data or these terms, open an issue on the GitHub repository below. The game’s artwork, audio and other resources remain subject to their respective licences. The home page lists their creators.
online_error_network: The devices could not connect. Check both networks, then try joining again.
online_error_no_candidates: Your browser could not find a network connection for this game. Check its WebRTC settings and any VPN or privacy extensions. In Opera, try the recommended WebRTC setting. Then reload the page and try again.
online_error_relay: The connection relay is unavailable. Please try again shortly. If the problem continues, contact the game owner.
movement_range_hint: Small dots show cells you can reach with your remaining movement. Click or tap a dot to follow the cheapest path, one cell at a time.
building_big_city_description: Earns 300$ at the start of each turn you own it. A major source of income for your army.
map_15_description: Thread your way between ponds and streets to capture the town’s two big cities and buildings.
editor_description: Commander, the next battlefield is in your hands. Draw terrain, place buildings and both armies, then export the JSON. You can also start from an existing map.
editor_submit_help: To submit a map, open a GitHub issue and paste the JSON in a code block, with a name, a short description and optionally a screenshot. Maps are reviewed before being added to the game.
legal_editor_storage: The map editor saves your latest draft in this browser’s local storage. It is not sent automatically. Export the JSON to keep a copy before clearing site data.
map_editor_tagline: Draw, place your armies, export your JSON.
map_editor_draft_local: Your draft stays in this browser.
map_editor_hint: Right-click: grass or unit eraser. Ctrl/Cmd + Z: undo. Painting water removes ground units from the tile.
map_editor_submit_prepare: Name your map and place a blue and a red army. Check that both sides can reach each other and the objectives.
map_editor_submit_export: Click “Export JSON” to download the file, or use “Copyable JSON”.
map_editor_submit_github: Open an issue on GitHub and paste your JSON in a code block. Include the map name, your gameplay idea and, if possible, a screenshot.
map_editor_review: Submissions are reviewed before being added to the game. The ID may be adjusted during integration.
map_editor_privacy: Your draft is saved only in this browser and is not sent automatically. Export it before leaving or clearing browser data.
map_editor_save_failed: Local saving unavailable: remember to export your JSON.
map_editor_copy_fallback: Select Copy in your browser or use Ctrl/Cmd + C.
map_editor_new_notice: New grid. Undo restores the previous one.
map_editor_loaded: Copy loaded: the original file is unchanged.
map_editor_too_large: The file is too large (maximum 2 MB).
map_editor_exported: Battle plan exported as JSON, Commander. You can submit it to propose your map for the game.
map_editor_exported_draft: JSON exported as a draft: add units for both sides before playing.
map_editor_restored: Your last battle plan has been recovered, Commander. Draft restored.
map_editor_restore_failed: The previous draft is unavailable. You can import JSON.
map_editor_error_dimensions: Dimensions must be between 2 and 32 tiles.
map_editor_error_ground: Ground units must be placed on land.
map_editor_error_json: The file must contain a valid JSON map.
map_editor_error_identity: The map needs a positive numeric ID and a name.
map_editor_error_cells: The tile count does not match the dimensions.
map_editor_error_cell: A tile has invalid terrain, ownership or capture points.
map_editor_error_building: A building must have a known type.
map_editor_error_unit: A unit is invalid or multiple units occupy the same tile.
map_editor_error_water: A ground unit is placed on water.
map_16_description: Cross the mountainous terrain and passages between lakes to capture the four big cities.
unit_transport_description: An unarmed jeep carrying up to three infantry units. Same speed, armor and price as a jeep. Passengers are lost if it is destroyed.
transport_rules: Transports carry up to 3 units. Transport jeeps and helicopters carry infantry. Transport ships carry infantry or ground vehicles. Move onto a friendly transport to board, using movement points. Unloading is free and preserves remaining actions. All passengers are lost if the transport is destroyed.
transport_blocked: No free land tile beside this transport.
transport_shortcut_hint: Select a loaded transport, press T or click Passengers, then choose a passenger and a highlighted land tile. Loading and unloading cannot be undone.
transport_board_hint: Move compatible friendly units onto this transport to board (up to 3).
transport_choose_tile: Select a highlighted tile to deploy. Escape cancels.
map_17_description: Command your army across an XXL battlefield of roads, lakes and mountain passes.
map_18_description: Choose your route across this sprawling 24 × 16 battlefield.
terrain_blocker_description: Only air units can cross this obstacle.
map_editor_error_blocker: Only air units can be placed on an obstacle.
unit_transport_helicopter_description: Flies over any terrain and carries up to three infantry units. Cannot attack. Its passengers are lost if it is destroyed.
map_19_description: Cross bridges between mountains and waterways to capture towns and build your army.
map_20_description: Secure the crossings and capture the buildings around the waterways.
map_21_description: Advance across a wide battlefield and secure the central big cities to sustain your army.
map_22_description: Wind through the roads between woods and waterways, capture the factories, and meet the opposing army at the crossroads.
map_23_description: Cross the central park, secure the airports, and capture the big cities along the edges.
map_24_description: Cross the bridges, capture the lakeside cities, and use transports to open new fronts.
naval_group_description: Sail on water and build ships at captured naval bases.
unit_attack_ship_description: A short-range surface combat ship. Cannot attack aircraft or capture buildings.
unit_transport_ship_description: Carries up to three infantry or ground vehicles. Unarmed. Passengers are lost if it sinks.
map_editor_error_naval: Naval units must be placed on water or a naval base.
naval_rules: Ships cross straight under bridges without stopping, even when ground units occupy the bridge. Each crossed tile costs 2 movement points, including the exit. The exit must be free and reachable with the remaining movement. Naval bases provide no income or repairs.
building_naval_base_description: Builds attack ships and transport ships. Infantry and ships can enter.
map_25_description: Capture the naval bases and find a way across the water where the bridge is broken.
map_26_description: Capture island cities, secure naval bases and carry your army across the water by sea and air.
terrain_void_description: Empty space used to shape the map. No unit can enter or cross it, including aircraft.
map_editor_error_void: No unit can be placed on a void tile.
tutorial_failed: Commander, we have no troops or recruitment options left. Restart the mission to try another approach.
tutorial_follow_step: For now, follow the current objective.
tutorial_enemy_hold: Report: red is holding position. No targets in range; they are passing their turn.
mission_summary: Your briefing, Commander: secure a foothold, build your force, then take the city across the river. The route is your decision. Red defends its sector. Your rear city funds replacements each turn.
mission_take_city: Our first objective is the marked northern city. Capture it with any infantry. Movement, combat and ending turns remain at your discretion.
mission_consolidate: The city is ours. Recruit any unit and hold the northern city until your next turn. A transport joins you after the first capture.
mission_cross_river: Final objective, Commander: capture the marked city on the far bank. Transport or land crossing, the route is your call.
mission_tip_move: Click a movement dot to travel there. Terrain determines the cost. You can switch units and finish their remaining actions later.
mission_tip_undo: Undo [undo] returns this unit and restores movement. Confirm [confirm] keeps its position. Attacking, capturing or boarding commits the move.
mission_tip_capture: Use Capture [capture]. A building needs two captures on separate turns. You can still use your remaining movement and attacks.
mission_tip_combat: Click an enemy in range to fire. A surviving enemy can retaliate if it has ammunition and can reach you. Both sides spend ammunition.
mission_tip_ammo: Report: this unit has no shots left. Use another unit, move to safety or end your turn to refresh actions.
mission_tip_heal: The medical team is ready. Your hospital restores up to 50 health at the start of your turn. Stay to heal, or keep advancing.
mission_tip_produce: Choose an affordable unit. New units have their normal actions immediately. If the base is occupied, move its unit away first.
mission_tip_recruit: Recruit a unit from your army base or naval base. Select an empty base to open production. Your cities provide income each turn if you need more funds.
mission_tip_hold: Reinforcement ready, Commander. Keep the northern city until your next turn to collect its income. Finish any other actions, then end the round.
mission_tip_board: To board, move infantry onto a friendly transport with enough movement remaining. Ships carry up to three ground units. The land crossings are another route.
mission_tip_unload: Open Passengers [cargo] or press T, select a passenger, then a highlighted shore tile. Unloading is free. Remaining actions are preserved.
mission_tip_ship: Ships move on water. Bring this transport beside friendly infantry to board, then beside a free shore tile to unload. A lost ship can be replaced at the naval base.
mission_tip_spent: This unit has used its movement. It may still attack or capture if those actions remain. Select another unit or end the round.
mission_tip_rebuild: Commander, we need infantry to capture buildings. Recruit at your army base. Your rear city still supplies income, so you can end turns to save for replacements.
mission_enemy_defend: Report: red is defending its sector. Watch its movement and ammunition.
mission_complete: Mission complete, Commander! Both banks are secured. Your troops remain at your command: continue playing or choose another battlefield.
profile_intro: Your campaign report, Commander. Your medals and nickname stay in this browser, without an account. These are personal records, not verified competitive scores.
medal_missing: Win on {difficulty} to earn this medal
profile_medal_rules: Each AI difficulty has its own medal. Winning earns only the medal for the difficulty played. Major map updates start a new medal set, while older medals remain in your backup.
profile_backup_help: Keep your service record safe: download a JSON backup before clearing browser data or changing device. It includes your nickname, medals, challenge records and settings, but not a match in progress. Without a backup, cleared progress cannot be recovered.
profile_replace_warning: Restoring replaces your current progress and settings. Download your current backup first if you want to keep it.
profile_invalid: This backup is invalid or exceeds 256 KB. Your progress has not changed.
profile_version_error: This backup version is not supported. Your progress has not changed.
profile_storage_error: Progress could not be read or saved in this browser. Download a backup from My progress to keep your medals.
support_intro: Commander, a call for reinforcements! Your support helps us prepare new maps, improve the game and keep the servers ready for the next turn.
support_gratitude: Thank you for the reinforcements, Commander. We’ll see you on the battlefield!
support_pending: Payment options will be available here soon. Thank you for playing!
support_paypal_scan: Scan this QR code or use the button above to contribute.
support_paypal_qr: PayPal QR code for supporting Pixel’s War
support_crypto_copy_failed: Could not copy the address. Select it above to copy it manually.
map_symmetrical_help: Terrain, buildings and starting armies match when the two sides are mirrored or rotated.
map_mobile_help: A narrow layout suited to portrait screens, with tiles estimated to stay readable without repeated zooming.
save_discard_confirm: Discard this unfinished match? Your medals and progress will be kept.
save_replace: Commander, a match on {map} is already saved. Starting a new match will replace it.
save_invalid: This save is damaged or uses an unsupported version. It has not been replaced. Discard it to start a new match.
save_conflict: The saved match changed in another tab. Autosave is paused here. Return home and resume the latest save.
save_storage: Automatic saving is unavailable in this browser. You can play, but progress in this match may be lost when you leave.
save_automatic: Solo matches save automatically after completed actions. If interrupted during the AI turn, that turn restarts from its beginning. Profile JSON backups do not include the match.
map_filter_empty: No maps match these filters, Commander. Try another size or remove a tag.
map_27_description: Bridges weave between islands toward a contested city centre. Seize the crossings and use your ships to open a second front.
map_drafts_hint: Drafts to test and refine. Visible only in development.
map_draft_editor_hint: Changes are saved locally for this draft. Export the JSON to update its source file. This does not publish the map.
map_28_description: A small symmetrical neighborhood with coveted cities around every corner. Capture buildings and grow your infantry force.
map_29_description: Two crossings connect the banks. Divide your forces to control the bridges and towns.
map_30_description: Choose between roads and shortcuts through rough terrain to reach the towns before your opponent.
map_31_description: A compact battlefield for infantry and vehicles. Control the roads and capture the central towns.
map_35_description: A small battlefield among forests and hills. Use the terrain to protect your advance.
map_36_description: Roads and waterways wind between the towns. Combine land and naval transports to open new fronts.
map_37_description: Control the central crossing or fly around enemy lines by helicopter. Towns scattered between the waterways await you.
map_38_description: Commander, several bridges open a path through the center. Capture the towns and choose your crossing to outflank enemy lines.
unit_artillery_ship_description: Commander, this ship bombards ground and naval units from 3–4 tiles away. Keep your distance: it cannot fire at close range or target aircraft.
